Tokyo Game Show Exhibit & Trial Version UpdateTokyo Game Show Exhibit & Trial Version Update

We will be exhibiting at the Tokyo Game Show to be held at Makuhari Messe from September 15~18, 2022.

We will exhibit a special 5~10 minute trial version of the game, free postcards, and a packaged version of the game to be released in the future.
We will also be revealing new information at the venue ahead of time.
We look forward to seeing you at the Indie Game Selection Exhibit A08.

We have also updated the demo version in conjunction with the Tokyo Game Show exhibition.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)
